raw.transcript: Gotcha. If you don’t know the router password, first look at the router itself—there’s often a sticker on the bottom or back with the default login, sometimes labeled “admin” and “password” or the Wi‑Fi name and key. If you changed it before and can’t remember, check your internet provider’s app or account page, since many let you view or reset Wi‑Fi settings there. If that’s not available, you can do a full reset by holding the reset pin for about 10 seconds, but that wipes custom settings, so you’ll set the Wi‑Fi name and password again from scratch. If you’re unsure, your provider’s support line can walk you through it safely.
